verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe a dedicated testing system that simulates transaction scenarios so developers can confirm a test integration works before switching to live. They also offer an Adyen test card, ordered from the test Customer Area, for testing card brands, CVMs and declined payments. This delivers the test-card side of the story, though Adyen itself calls the system 'basic' and the card is a physical item you must order. Missing for 10: evidence of a software-simulated or virtual reader that needs no hardware, detailed coverage of which end-to-end scenarios the test system supports, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow.
